variants.timer: CSS offset fix plus skip timer cleanup when task deadlines are disabled.
variants.combined: Timer variant plus one pending setImmediate dispatch callback.

comparisons: Timer and CSS compare timer against before. Dispatch compares combined against timer. Crawl comparisons compare combined against before. Each includes an identical-code control.

suites.method: Fresh process per variant per round, including MDN. Rotate/reverse order: each variant occupies each position twice. One process median contributes per case per round.
suites.noiseRule: Four-million-iteration CPU probes bracket timed work. Five warm-ups and nine calibrations set a 1.5x median threshold before comparisons. Reject the entire three-variant group for any measured probe above threshold. Require four qualifying groups. No filtering by candidate result.
suites.scope: Disabled cleanup: 100000 calls to the actual internal method with an empty timer map. Enabled cleanup: cancel 2000 real timers prepared outside timing. CSS: 128 parses of 256 ordinary, unambiguous URL matches; all offsets and output hashes verified.
